brand.name: Tesla
brand.tagline: American electric-car maker, in India since 2025
brand.description: American electric-vehicle and energy company founded in 2003. Entered India in July 2025 with a showroom in Mumbai, followed by Delhi; cars are imported as completely built units and sold direct to customers online and through Tesla stores.

models.name: Model Y

ev.dcCharge: Up to 175 kW; 238 km added in 15 min (Supercharger)

items: Heated and ventilated power front seats
Eight exterior cameras with surround view
All-black interior; Zen Grey optional at extra cost
Full-width LED light bars front and rear

highlights: Imported fully built; sold direct by Tesla India
Full Self-Driving (Supervised) package optional at ₹6 lakh
Stealth Grey is the only no-cost paint colour
models.notes: tesla.com/en_in blocked automated reading (HTTP 403); price and specs taken from Autocar India / DriveSpark reports of Tesla's figures. 2026 Premium RWD priced at ₹50.89 lakh ex-showroom from 29 May 2026; the Long Range Premium RWD (₹67.89 lakh) was discontinued then. Ex-showroom is uniform nationally. Tesla does not publish battery size or motor output for India; 64 kWh is as reported by DriveSpark/Autocar (Team-BHP quotes 60 kWh). Airbag count conflicts between reports (7 vs 9) so left null. Boot: Tesla quotes up to 2,138 L total cargo with seats folded; reports cite 822 L + 117 L frunk seats-up. Paint options cost extra (₹95,000–₹1.85 lakh). Euro NCAP 5 stars (2025) is for the current-generation Model Y.

models.notes: tesla.com/en_in blocked automated reading (HTTP 403); figures from Autocar India reports of Tesla's claims. Launched 22 April 2026 at ₹61.99 lakh ex-showroom, unchanged since. Battery capacity is not published by Tesla: 88.2 kWh is Autocar's estimate from the Australian-spec car. Power/torque not published (estimates of 514 hp / 590 Nm omitted). 0–100 km/h improved from 5.0 s to 4.5 s for cars bought on or after 1 Oct 2026. Ground clearance 169 mm and dimensions as reported by Autocar. Paint other than Stealth Grey costs extra. Listed as a separate model because Tesla markets it as 'Model Y L' with its own body and dimensions; check whether the site should merge it into tesla-model-y.
